description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Timeline' which renders a timeline visualization for trace events, resources, and console messages in a UI. It manages user interactions such as selecting, resizing, and moving time windows, and displays bars representing actions, network resources, and console messages with visual indicators.

methods.name: calculateDividerOffsets
methods.description: Calculates the positions and timestamps of timeline dividers based on the client width and boundaries, adjusting for optimal spacing.

methods.name: timeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a pixel position within the timeline given the client width and boundaries.

methods.name: positionToTime
methods.description: Converts a pixel position within the timeline to a timestamp based on the boundaries.

methods.name: barTop
methods.description: Determines the vertical position (top offset) for a timeline bar, based on whether it corresponds to a resource or action.
